sources.title: OSMnx (Python over Overpass)

sources.verified_2026_08_29: v2.0.7 installed; live Guwahati bbox fetch returned 116 nodes/272 edges.

sources.access_note: Free but needs a CDS token in ~/.cdsapirc (one-time signup).

sources.title: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (30 m)

sources.title: NASA Global Landslide Catalog (COOLR) — NER landslide incidents
sources.access_note: Direct CSV, no auth. THE real label source: dated point landslides.
sources.verified_2026_08_29: Downloaded 8.5 MB / 11,033 rows; NER=442 (344 state-named), all with lat/lon+event_date, 2007-04-11..2016-10-15; 291 name road impact.

sources.title: Dartmouth Flood Observatory — Global Flood Records
sources.access_note: Dated floods but COUNTRY-level (no lat/lon in CSV) — too coarse to localize to a road. Usable only as coarse flood context, not point labels.
sources.verified_2026_08_29: CSV 5,502 rows 1985-2023; India=316 at country granularity.
